WITH water_level AS (
    SELECT
        hour_start,
        date_key,
        time_key,
        location_key,
        water_level_station_key,
        water_level_mean,
        water_level_max,
        water_level_obs_count,
        water_level_present,
        water_level_usable
    FROM "iceberg"."dw"."fact_water_level"
),

thresholds AS (
    SELECT
        station_key,
        station_code,
        alarm_level_1_m,
        alarm_level_2_m,
        alarm_level_3_m,
        legal_document,
        effective_from,
        vertical_datum,
        datum_status
    FROM "iceberg"."dw"."dim_flood_threshold"
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        w.*,
        t.station_code,
        t.alarm_level_1_m,
        t.alarm_level_2_m,
        t.alarm_level_3_m,
        t.legal_document,
        t.effective_from,
        t.vertical_datum,
        t.datum_status,

        CASE
            WHEN t.station_key IS NULL
                THEN 'THRESHOLD_NOT_FOUND'
            WHEN t.datum_status = 'VERIFIED'
                THEN 'DATUM_VERIFIED'
            ELSE 'REFERENCE_ONLY'
        END AS threshold_comparison_status,

        CASE
            WHEN t.effective_from IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(w.hour_start AS DATE) >= t.effective_from
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS within_legal_effective_period

    FROM water_level w
    LEFT JOIN thresholds t
        ON w.water_level_station_key = t.station_key
),

classified AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN NOT COALESCE(water_level_usable, FALSE)
                OR water_level_max IS NULL
                OR water_level_obs_count IS NULL
                OR water_level_obs_count <= 0
                OR alarm_level_1_m IS NULL
                OR alarm_level_2_m IS NULL
                OR alarm_level_3_m IS NULL
                THEN 'UNKNOWN'

            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_3_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_3_OR_ABOVE'

            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_2_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_2'

            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_1_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_1'

            ELSE 'BELOW_LEVEL_1'
        END AS reference_alarm_level

    FROM joined
)

SELECT
    hour_start,
    date_key,
    time_key,
    location_key,
    water_level_station_key,
    station_code,

    water_level_mean,
    water_level_max,
    water_level_obs_count,
    water_level_present,
    water_level_usable,

    alarm_level_1_m,
    alarm_level_2_m,
    alarm_level_3_m,

    legal_document,
    effective_from,
    vertical_datum,
    datum_status,
    threshold_comparison_status,
    within_legal_effective_period,

    reference_alarm_level,

    CASE
        WHEN datum_status = 'VERIFIED'
             AND within_legal_effective_period = TRUE
             AND reference_alarm_level <> 'UNKNOWN'
            THEN reference_alarm_level
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)
    END AS official_alarm_level

FROM classified

    group by threshold_comparison_status

)

select *

WITH expected AS (
    SELECT
        hour_start,
        location_key,
        reference_alarm_level,

        CASE
            WHEN NOT COALESCE(water_level_usable, FALSE)
              OR water_level_max IS NULL
              OR water_level_obs_count IS NULL
              OR water_level_obs_count <= 0
              OR alarm_level_1_m IS NULL
              OR alarm_level_2_m IS NULL
              OR alarm_level_3_m IS NULL
                THEN 'UNKNOWN'
            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_3_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_3_OR_ABOVE'
            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_2_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_2'
            WHEN water_level_max >= alarm_level_1_m
                THEN 'LEVEL_1'
            ELSE 'BELOW_LEVEL_1'
        END AS expected_level

    FROM "iceberg"."marts"."mart_flood_risk"
)

SELECT *
FROM expected
WHERE reference_alarm_level <> expected_level
   OR reference_alarm_level IS NULL

SELECT *
FROM "iceberg"."marts"."mart_flood_risk"
WHERE
    (
        alarm_level_1_m IS NOT NULL
        AND alarm_level_2_m IS NOT NULL
        AND alarm_level_3_m IS NOT NULL
        AND NOT (
            alarm_level_1_m < alarm_level_2_m
            AND alarm_level_2_m < alarm_level_3_m
        )
    )
    OR (
        official_alarm_level IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            datum_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'VERIFIED'
            OR within_legal_effective_period IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
            OR reference_alarm_level = 'UNKNOWN'
        )
    )
    OR (
        datum_status = 'UNVERIFIED'
        AND threshold_comparison_status <> 'REFERENCE_ONLY'
    )

with quality_base as (

    select
        hour_start,
        date_key,
        time_key,
        location_key,

        weather_quality_flag,
        weather_present,
        weather_usable,

        rainfall_quality_flag,
        rainfall_present,
        rainfall_usable,

        discharge_quality_flag,
        discharge_present,
        discharge_usable,

        water_level_quality_flag,
        water_level_present,
        water_level_usable,

        tide_quality_flag,
        tide_present,
        tide_usable,
        tide_recovery_method,

        present_source_count,
        usable_source_count,
        all_five_present,
        all_five_usable

    from "iceberg"."marts_staging"."stg_fact_data_quality"

)

select
    *,

    5 - present_source_count
        as missing_source_count,

    present_source_count - usable_source_count
        as unusable_source_count,

    cast(present_source_count as double) / 5.0
        as source_presence_ratio,

    cast(usable_source_count as double) / 5.0
        as source_usability_ratio,

    case
        when usable_source_count = 5
            then 'COMPLETE'
        when usable_source_count = 0
            then 'NO_USABLE_DATA'
        else 'PARTIAL'
    end as quality_status

from quality_base

with rainfall_base as (

    select
        hour_start,
        date_key,
        time_key,
        location_key,
        rainfall_mm,
        rainfall_quality_flag,
        rainfall_present,
        rainfall_usable,

        case
            when rainfall_usable = true
                 and rainfall_mm is not null
            then rainfall_mm
            else null
        end as valid_rainfall_mm

    from "iceberg"."marts_staging"."stg_fact_rainfall"

),

rolling_metrics as (

    select
        *,

        count(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_valid_hours_3h,

        sum(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_raw_sum_3h,

        count(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 5 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_valid_hours_6h,

        sum(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 5 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_raw_sum_6h,

        count(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 11 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_valid_hours_12h,

        sum(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 11 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_raw_sum_12h,

        count(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 23 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_valid_hours_24h,

        sum(valid_rainfall_mm) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 23 preceding and current row
        ) as rainfall_raw_sum_24h

    from rainfall_base

)

select
    hour_start,
    date_key,
    time_key,
    location_key,
    rainfall_mm,
    rainfall_quality_flag,
    rainfall_present,
    rainfall_usable,

    rainfall_valid_hours_3h,
    case when rainfall_valid_hours_3h = 3
        then rainfall_raw_sum_3h
    end as rainfall_sum_3h_mm,

    rainfall_valid_hours_6h,
    case when rainfall_valid_hours_6h = 6
        then rainfall_raw_sum_6h
    end as rainfall_sum_6h_mm,

    rainfall_valid_hours_12h,
    case when rainfall_valid_hours_12h = 12
        then rainfall_raw_sum_12h
    end as rainfall_sum_12h_mm,

    rainfall_valid_hours_24h,
    case when rainfall_valid_hours_24h = 24
        then rainfall_raw_sum_24h
    end as rainfall_sum_24h_mm

from rolling_metrics

with water_level_base as (

    select
        hour_start,
        date_key,
        time_key,
        location_key,
        water_level_station_key,
        water_level_mean,
        water_level_min,
        water_level_max,
        water_level_last,
        water_level_last_timestamp,
        water_level_obs_count,
        water_level_total_rows,
        water_level_on_grid_count,
        water_level_off_grid_count,
        water_level_non_observed_count,
        water_level_expected_count,
        water_level_completeness,
        water_level_quality_flag,
        water_level_present,
        water_level_usable,

        case
            when water_level_usable = true
                 and water_level_mean is not null
                 and water_level_max is not null
                 and water_level_obs_count > 0
            then water_level_mean
        end as valid_water_level_mean,

        case
            when water_level_usable = true
                 and water_level_mean is not null
                 and water_level_max is not null
                 and water_level_obs_count > 0
            then water_level_max
        end as valid_water_level_max

    from "iceberg"."marts_staging"."stg_fact_water_level"

),

rolling_metrics as (

    select
        *,

        count(valid_water_level_mean) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as water_level_valid_hours_3h,

        avg(valid_water_level_mean) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as raw_mean_3h,

        count(valid_water_level_mean) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 5 preceding and current row
        ) as water_level_valid_hours_6h,

        avg(valid_water_level_mean) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 5 preceding and current row
        ) as raw_mean_6h,

        count(valid_water_level_max) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 23 preceding and current row
        ) as water_level_valid_hours_24h,

        max(valid_water_level_max) over (
            partition by location_key
            order by hour_start
            rows between 23 preceding and current row
        ) as raw_max_24h

    from water_level_base

)

select

    date_key,
    time_key,
    location_key,
    water_level_station_key,

    water_level_mean,
    water_level_min,
    water_level_max,
    water_level_last,

    water_level_on_grid_count,
    water_level_off_grid_count,
    water_level_non_observed_count,
    water_level_expected_count,
    water_level_completeness,

    water_level_quality_flag,
    water_level_present,
    water_level_usable,

    water_level_valid_hours_3h,
    case
        when water_level_valid_hours_3h = 3
        then raw_mean_3h
    end as water_level_mean_3h_m,

    water_level_valid_hours_6h,
    case
        when water_level_valid_hours_6h = 6
        then raw_mean_6h
    end as water_level_mean_6h_m,

    water_level_valid_hours_24h,
    case
        when water_level_valid_hours_24h = 24
        then raw_max_24h
    end as water_level_max_24h_m

from rolling_metrics

    water_level_mean_6h_m,

    -- Data quality
    water_level_quality_flag,
    water_level_present,
    water_level_usable

from "iceberg"."marts_intermediate"."int_water_level_metrics"

with all_values as (

    select
        quality_status as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"
    group by quality_status

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'COMPLETE','PARTIAL','NO_USABLE_DATA'
)

with quality_checks as (

    select
        *,

        (
            case when weather_present then 1 else 0 end +
            case when rainfall_present then 1 else 0 end +
            case when discharge_present then 1 else 0 end +
            case when water_level_present then 1 else 0 end +
            case when tide_present then 1 else 0 end
        ) as calculated_present_count,

        (
            case when weather_usable then 1 else 0 end +
            case when rainfall_usable then 1 else 0 end +
            case when discharge_usable then 1 else 0 end +
            case when water_level_usable then 1 else 0 end +
            case when tide_usable then 1 else 0 end
        ) as calculated_usable_count

    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"

)

select
    hour_start,
    location_key,
    present_source_count,
    usable_source_count,
    calculated_present_count,
    calculated_usable_count,
    quality_status

from quality_checks

where
    -- Source counts
    present_source_count is distinct from calculated_present_count
    or usable_source_count is distinct from calculated_usable_count

    -- Derived counts
    or missing_source_count is distinct from
        (5 - present_source_count)

    or unusable_source_count is distinct from
        (present_source_count - usable_source_count)

    -- Ratios
    or source_presence_ratio is distinct from
        (cast(present_source_count as double) / 5.0)

    or source_usability_ratio is distinct from
        (cast(usable_source_count as double) / 5.0)

    -- Overall flags
    or all_five_present is distinct from
        (present_source_count = 5)

    or all_five_usable is distinct from
        (usable_source_count = 5)

    -- Status classification
    or quality_status is distinct from
        (
            case
                when usable_source_count = 5 then 'COMPLETE'
                when usable_source_count = 0 then 'NO_USABLE_DATA'
                else 'PARTIAL'
            end
        )

    -- Usable data must also be present
    or (weather_usable and not weather_present)
    or (rainfall_usable and not rainfall_present)
    or (discharge_usable and not discharge_present)
    or (water_level_usable and not water_level_present)
    or (tide_usable and not tide_present)

select hour_start
from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"
where hour_start is null

select location_key
from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"
where location_key is null

select quality_status
from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"
where quality_status is null

with rainfall_checks as (

    select
        hour_start,
        location_key,

        rainfall_valid_hours_3h,
        rainfall_sum_3h_mm,

        rainfall_valid_hours_6h,
        rainfall_sum_6h_mm,

        rainfall_valid_hours_12h,
        rainfall_sum_12h_mm,

        rainfall_valid_hours_24h,
        rainfall_sum_24h_mm

    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_rainfall"

)

select *
from rainfall_checks

where
    -- 3-hour window
    rainfall_valid_hours_3h is null
    or rainfall_valid_hours_3h < 0
    or rainfall_valid_hours_3h > 3
    or (
        rainfall_valid_hours_3h = 3
        and rainfall_sum_3h_mm is null
    )
    or (
        rainfall_valid_hours_3h < 3
        and rainfall_sum_3h_mm is not null
    )

    -- 6-hour window
    or rainfall_valid_hours_6h is null

    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_rainfall"

    union all

    select
        hour_start,
        location_key,
        'data_quality' as source_name
    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_data_quality"

),

key_coverage as (

    select
        hour_start,
        location_key,
        count(distinct source_name) as mart_count

    from all_keys

    group by
        hour_start,
        location_key

)

    from "iceberg"."marts"."mart_water_level"
